call-rules.q: A dealer asks exactly where our leads come from. What do you say?
options: Name the ad platform we use
"Our hybrid lead engine," and stop there
"I'm not allowed to tell you" and hang up
Read them the lead's description field
call-rules.correct: "Our hybrid lead engine," and stop there
call-rules.explanation: Lead source never leaves GSD. Say 'our hybrid lead engine' and stop.

call-rules.q: A prospect says "add us to your do-not-call list." What do you do?
options: Give one last quick pitch first
Say you'll remove them, apologize, hang up and mark DNC in the phone system and Zoho before the next dial
Mark it at the end of the day
call-rules.correct: Say you'll remove them, apologize, hang up and mark DNC in the phone system and Zoho before the next dial
call-rules.explanation: No 'but', no second pitch. DNC is marked before your next dial.

call-rules.q: It's fine to tell a skeptical owner how many appointments a week other clients get, to build trust.
call-rules.explanation: No numbers we can't prove. Offer proof on screen instead.

call-rules.q: When should you speak after the prospect picks up?
options: After 5 seconds so they don't feel rushed

call-opener.q: What is the goal of the opener?
options: Get permission for 30 seconds, then ask one question
Ask for the owner's cell phone
call-opener.correct: Get permission for 30 seconds, then ask one question
call-opener.explanation: Permission, then one question, then silence.

call-opener.q: Which line is part of the GSD opener?
options: "I'm calling to compete for your business the good old-fashioned way."
call-opener.correct: "I'm calling to compete for your business the good old-fashioned way."
call-opener.explanation: Honest and disarming; it has opened many real conversations.

call-opener.q: How should you handle mentioning that you're calling from Colombia?
options: Say it once, confidently, then go straight to the question
call-opener.correct: Say it once, confidently, then go straight to the question
call-opener.explanation: It's an advantage: same time zone, bilingual team.

call-gatekeeper.q: An automated call screener asks for your name and reason. What's the best answer?
options: "{Your name}, GSD 500 BPO, about bilingual appointment setting for water-treatment dealers."
call-gatekeeper.correct: "{Your name}, GSD 500 BPO, about bilingual appointment setting for water-treatment dealers."

call-gatekeeper.q: If the decision maker isn't available, which three things do you collect?
options: Their home address, age and budget
Whether they have bilingual setters (in-house or outsourced), the owner's best email, and the name of who you spoke to
Their credit card, email and fax
call-gatekeeper.correct: Whether they have bilingual setters (in-house or outsourced), the owner's best email, and the name of who you spoke to
call-gatekeeper.explanation: Those three make the callback land.

call-gatekeeper.q: When calling back on an agreement, you should name the specific time and promise (e.g. "he asked me to call at 10 AM today").
call-gatekeeper.explanation: A vague 'he told me to call back' gets sent to voicemail.

call-discovery.q: How many discovery questions should you ask on a typical call?
options: None; go straight to the pitch

call-discovery.q: A prospect says "everything is on paper." Which service does that open?
call-discovery.explanation: No CRM = speed-to-lead and follow-up automation.

call-discovery.q: Halfway through discovery you should check in: "Am I talking too fast, or is everything okay so far?"
call-discovery.explanation: It keeps the prospect engaged and shows respect.

call-pitch.q: How many services should you pitch?
options: All of them, so they see the full value
The 1 or 2 that match what you heard in discovery
Whatever the prospect asks about first
call-pitch.correct: The 1 or 2 that match what you heard in discovery

call-pitch.q: A prospect says "we need more leads." What do you offer first?
options: A few test leads from our hybrid lead engine, then the terms your manager approves
call-pitch.correct: A few test leads from our hybrid lead engine, then the terms your manager approves
call-pitch.explanation: Start with test leads so the risk is on us.

call-pitch.q: You may improvise a price if it helps close the meeting.
call-pitch.explanation: Pricing comes only from the manager's current rate card. Unauthorized pricing is a critical fail.

call-booking.q: How do you ask for the appointment?
options: Two specific options: "tomorrow at 11 or Thursday at 2, your time — which works better?"
call-booking.correct: Two specific options: "tomorrow at 11 or Thursday at 2, your time — which works better?"
call-booking.explanation: Two specific options in their time zone.

call-booking.q: Which three things must you have before ending a live call?
options: Date and time, an email for the invite, and a channel for the reminder
Their budget, title and company size
call-booking.correct: Date and time, an email for the invite, and a channel for the reminder
call-booking.explanation: Calls that ended on 'I'll send you an email' stalled.

call-booking.q: When should the confirmation call happen?
options: 30 to 60 minutes before the meeting (plus the day-before confirmation)
call-booking.correct: 30 to 60 minutes before the meeting (plus the day-before confirmation)
call-booking.explanation: Confirm the day before and again 30–60 minutes before.

call-booking.q: You should ask the prospect to be in front of a computer so they can see the calendars.

call-objections.q: "How did you get my number?" Best answer:
options: "You're listed as an authorized dealer on {brand}'s public dealer locator. That's where I found you."
call-objections.correct: "You're listed as an authorized dealer on {brand}'s public dealer locator. That's where I found you."
call-objections.explanation: Specific and true keeps the call alive.

call-objections.q: "I don't have a lot of time / call me later." What do you do?
options: Offer two specific times (tonight after 8 or tomorrow morning) and confirm the email
call-objections.correct: Offer two specific times (tonight after 8 or tomorrow morning) and confirm the email
call-objections.explanation: 'Ok, sure' with no time is a lost lead.

options: Offering real calendars and recordings on screen, starting with test leads so the risk is on us
call-objections.correct: Offering real calendars and recordings on screen, starting with test leads so the risk is on us

call-objections.q: If a prospect repeats "not interested" or says stop, you exit politely and mark them DNC.

call-voicemail.q: How many times do you say the callback number?
A voicemail should list every GSD service so the prospect knows the full menu.
call-voicemail.explanation: Monologues listing everything are what we avoid.

call-sms.q: Which line do texts go out from?
Someone replies STOP. What do you do?
options: Don't reply with a pitch; mark opt-out/DNC in the phone system and Zoho the same day; stop all contact
call-sms.correct: Don't reply with a pitch; mark opt-out/DNC in the phone system and Zoho the same day; stop all contact

call-sms.q: Marketing texts may go out between 8 a.m. and 8 p.m. in the lead's time zone.
You may fire a bulk SMS to a list on your own if the template is already approved.
call-sms.explanation: Bulk sends need the full pre-send checklist and a second explicit go from your manager.

graduation-333.q: What are the three phases of the 3-3-3 program?
options: 3 calls WITH your manager, 3 OBSERVED calls, 3 calls ALONE
graduation-333.correct: 3 calls WITH your manager, 3 OBSERVED calls, 3 calls ALONE
graduation-333.explanation: Then you graduate and own your pipeline.

graduation-333.q: What average QA score do you need on Phase 2 and Phase 3 calls?
One critical fail (e.g. revealing the lead source or ignoring STOP) resets that phase.
graduation-333.explanation: Zero critical fails is required to move on.

graduation-333.q: A voicemail counts as one of your 3-3-3 calls.
graduation-333.explanation: Only live conversations with real prospects count.
